summary: Ambev S.A., a Brazilian beverage company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a Board of Directors meeting held on May 15, 2026. The Board approved the replacement of current Vice-President of Logistics, Paulo Andr Zagman, by Fernando Maffessoni, effective August 1, 2026. This is a routine management succession, with Mr. Maffessoni moving from a logistics role at affiliate Anheuser-Busch InBev. No financial terms, premiums, or strategic transactions are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report corresponding to a US current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. Watch for potential operational continuity.
